nodes.name: Normalize Intake and Initial Role Task

parameters.query:
WITH input_json AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
input_data AS (
  SELECT
    p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id,
    p->>'idempotency_key' AS idempotency_key,
    p->>'status' AS status,
    p->>'current_state' AS current_state,
    p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name,
    p->>'current_phase' AS current_phase,
    p->>'target_branch_name' AS target_branch_name,
    (p->>'max_retries')::integer AS max_retries,
    p->>'event_type' AS event_type,
    COALESCE(p->'event_payload_json','{}'::jsonb) AS event_payload_json,
    p->>'phase_run_id' AS phase_run_id,
    COALESCE(p->>'phase_status','phase_run_created') AS phase_status,
    COALESCE(p->'root_task_json','{}'::jsonb) AS root_task_json,
    p->>'role_task_id' AS role_task_id,
    NULLIF(p->>'parent_role_task_id','') AS parent_role_task_id,
    (p->>'sequence_no')::integer AS sequence_no,
    p->>'role_id' AS role_id,
    p->>'task_type' AS task_type,
    COALESCE(p->'task_payload_json','{}'::jsonb) AS task_payload_json,
    COALESCE(p->'context_refs_json','{}'::jsonb) AS context_refs_json,
    p->>'expected_output_schema_ref' AS expected_output_schema_ref,
    COALESCE(p->>'role_task_status','role_task_ready') AS role_task_status,
    COALESCE((p->>'role_task_attempt')::integer,0) AS role_task_attempt,
    COALESCE((p->>'role_task_max_retries')::integer,3) AS role_task_max_retries
  FROM input_json
),
upserted_legacy_run AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_runs (
    workflow_run_id,
    idempotency_key,
    status,
    current_state,
    repository_full_name,
    current_phase,
    target_branch_name,
    max_retries,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    workflow_run_id,
    idempotency_key,
    status,
    current_state,
    repository_full_name,
    current_phase,
    target_branch_name,
    max_retries,
    now(),
    now()
  FROM input_data
  ON CONFLICT (workflow_run_id) DO UPDATE SET
    idempotency_key = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.idempotency_key,
    status = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.status,
    current_state = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.current_state,
    repository_full_name = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.repository_full_name,
    current_phase = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.current_phase,
    target_branch_name = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.target_branch_name,
    max_retries = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.max_retries,
    updated_at = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.updated_at
  RETURNING
    workflow_run_id,
    status,
    current_state,
    repository_full_name,
    current_phase,
    target_branch_name,
    retry_count,
    max_retries,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    (xmax = 0) AS inserted
),
inserted_legacy_event AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (
    workflow_run_id,
    previous_state,
    new_state,
    event_type,
    event_payload_json,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    u.workflow_run_id,
    NULL,
    u.current_state,
    d.event_type,
    d.event_payload_json,
    now()
  FROM upserted_legacy_run u
  CROSS JOIN input_data d
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM moex_n8n_workflow_run_events e
    WHERE e.workflow_run_id = u.workflow_run_id
      AND e.event_type = d.event_type
  )
  RETURNING event_id
),
upserted_phase_run AS (
  INSERT INTO public.route_b_phase_runs (
    phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    repository_full_name,
    root_task_json,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    repository_full_name,
    root_task_json,
    phase_status,
    now(),
    now()
  FROM input_data
  ON CONFLICT (workflow_run_id) DO UPDATE SET
    repository_full_name = public.route_b_phase_runs.repository_full_name,
    root_task_json = public.route_b_phase_runs.root_task_json,
    status = public.route_b_phase_runs.status,
    blocker_code = public.route_b_phase_runs.blocker_code,
    updated_at = public.route_b_phase_runs.updated_at
  RETURNING
    phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    repository_full_name,
    status AS phase_status,
    created_at AS phase_created_at,
    updated_at AS phase_updated_at,
    (xmax = 0) AS phase_inserted
),
upserted_initial_role_task AS (
  INSERT INTO public.route_b_role_task_queue (
    phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    role_task_id,
    parent_role_task_id,
    sequence_no,
    role_id,
    task_type,
    task_payload_json,
    context_refs_json,
    expected_output_schema_ref,
    status,
    attempt,
    max_retries,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    role_task_id,
    parent_role_task_id,
    sequence_no,
    role_id,
    task_type,
    task_payload_json,
    context_refs_json,
    expected_output_schema_ref,
    role_task_status,
    role_task_attempt,
    role_task_max_retries,
    now()
  FROM input_data
  ON CONFLICT (role_task_id) DO UPDATE SET
    phase_run_id = public.route_b_role_task_queue.phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id = public.route_b_role_task_queue.workflow_run_id,
    parent_role_task_id = public.route_b_role_task_queue.parent_role_task_id,
    sequence_no = public.route_b_role_task_queue.sequence_no,
    role_id = public.route_b_role_task_queue.role_id,
    task_type = public.route_b_role_task_queue.task_type,
    task_payload_json = public.route_b_role_task_queue.task_payload_json,
    context_refs_json = public.route_b_role_task_queue.context_refs_json,
    expected_output_schema_ref = public.route_b_role_task_queue.expected_output_schema_ref,
    status = public.route_b_role_task_queue.status,
    attempt = public.route_b_role_task_queue.attempt,
    max_retries = public.route_b_role_task_queue.max_retries
  RETURNING
    phase_run_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    role_task_id,
    role_id,
    task_type,
    expected_output_schema_ref,
    status AS role_task_status,
    sequence_no,
    attempt,
    max_retries,
    created_at AS role_task_created_at,
    (xmax = 0) AS role_task_inserted
)
SELECT
  u.workflow_run_id,
  u.status,
  u.current_state,
  u.repository_full_name,
  u.current_phase,
  u.target_branch_name,
  u.retry_count,
  u.max_retries,
  u.created_at,
  u.updated_at,
  u.inserted,
  NOT u.inserted AS idempotent_replay,
  (SELECT event_id FROM inserted_legacy_event LIMIT 1) AS event_id,
  p.phase_run_id,
  p.phase_status,
  p.phase_inserted,
  t.role_task_id,
  t.role_id,
  t.role_task_status,
  t.expected_output_schema_ref,
  t.role_task_inserted
FROM upserted_legacy_run u
JOIN upserted_phase_run p ON p.workflow_run_id = u.workflow_run_id
JOIN upserted_initial_role_task t ON t.workflow_run_id = u.workflow_run_id;
